1 Classic: all questions of a page; Next saves the page (data-model.md: Answer rows, page by page) and checks required answers and formats on the server too. Back never loses answers.
2 Errors: a summary at the top takes the focus and links to each question; each question shows its error and gets a red edge; texts say what to do, not only that something is wrong.
3 Keyboard and screen readers in both layouts; WCAG 2.2 AA; Lighthouse ≥ 95 on the runner (ui-design-system.md, Quality gates).
4 One at a time: big type, one question, progress as “Question 4 of 9”; auto-advance only where one tap answers it (with a short pause), never for multiple choice or text.
5 States: end page, closed, not yet open, already answered (invitations), resume (“Welcome back”), error with reference, not found — each DE and EN, chosen by the survey's languages and the browser.
7 Welcome page (optional, on by default): title, intro text, estimated duration (from the number of questions), anonymity and privacy note, Start; respondents who come back skip it.

6 All W7 types and looks use the shared controls; logic (show/hide/skip), quotas and the respondent's language switch follow later work items; the switch here only shows when the survey has more than one language.
Layout choice per survey: a setting in the designer (Survey settings), default classic. No account needed to answer; nothing is tracked beyond what the anonymity mode allows.
